resources.string: Apply the existing classification to all %1$d groups? Selected groups stay together from their first position, retaining their original relative order. With all groups selected, the existing order stays unchanged. Names, profiles and subscription sources are not changed.

Bring these %1$d matching groups together at the first matched position? Matching groups and all other groups each keep their original relative order. Names, profiles and subscription sources are not changed.

Bring these %1$d selected groups together at the first selected position? Selected and unselected groups each keep their original relative order. Names, profiles and subscription sources are not changed.
